agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario shows sensor_noise-driven destabilization. With dt~0.015s and sensor_noise~0.015, the state-feedback controller receives noisy measurements of theta/omega each step. Gains adapt to the plant but noise causes persistent control error (forces ~37-42 N, well below limit). Over 43 steps (~0.65s) the pole angle and angular rate diverge: theta grows from 0.017 rad at step 0 to 0.22 at step 38, 0.44 at step 40, 0.71 at step 42, then 0.86 rad at step 43 exceeding the 0.8 rad pole_upright limit, with omega reaching ~10 rad/s and cart velocity ~-8 m/s. Energy rises to ~37.5 (vs ~1.45 initial) fed by controller work ~36.1, showing positive feedback. Removing only sensor_noise eliminates the violation, confirming noise as cause.
